summary.result: Based on the results, the passive sampler using the change of turbidity in the Ba(OH)₂ aqueous solution appears to be a suitable tool for measuring short-term atmospheric concentrations of CO₂.
summary.background: In this study, we investigated the applicability of a short-term carbon dioxide (CO₂) passive sampler using turbidity change in a solution containing barium hydroxide (Ba(OH)₂).
summary.method: Both unexposed (blank) and exposed samplers remained stable during the storage period of at least two weeks.
